name: Data.exists_isTidy_diagonalPeriodForm_eq
summary: Average the level-tidy datum of `Data.exists_isLevelTidy_iotaPlus_eq` (b = 0) over coset representatives t(x) of the node levels, weighted by their edge characters: this makes it equivariant for all admissible families (tidy of order 4m); the identity follows from `Data.diagonalPeriodForm_tupleAction` and the index ratios of `Data.triangleOrder_eq_mul_levelIndex`.

steps.claim: Constants κ(j) with triangleOrder(false, ϑ, j) = κ(j)·levelIndex(ϑ, false, 0, j) (`Data.triangleOrder_eq_mul_levelIndex`).
For every ϑ the level-tidy Φ(ϑ) of order 2m on the legs with the identity e (`Data.exists_isLevelTidy_iotaPlus_eq` at b = 0).
steps.lean: choose Φ q e using (@exists_isLevelTidy_iotaPlus_eq _ D · 0 zero_le)

steps.claim: For a family x of cosets of the node levels at (z, 0, i), i < m, let t′(x) be the family of chosen representatives at these nodes and 1 elsewhere.
steps.lean:
let t' {ϑ} (x : ∀ p : _ × Fin D.m, _ ⧸ D.nodeLevel ϑ (p.1, 0, p.2)) : ∀ p, GL _ _
    | (z, 0, i) => if h : _ then (x (z, ⟨i, h⟩)).out else 1 | _ => 1

steps.claim: Let t(x) be t′(x) with its value at (0, 0) of the grid Z replaced by the block extension of that of V.
steps.lean: let t {ϑ} x := update (@t' ϑ x) (_, 0, 0) (blockInlGL (gridDiagEquiv ..) (t' x (_, 0, 0)))

steps.claim: Take C = κ(m)·∏_{j<m} κ(j) and Λ(ϑ) = bind(Φ(ϑ), weights edgeCharProd(t(x), path(0)), tuples tupleAction(t(x)⁻¹, S)) over the coset families x: a short sum of order 2m + 2m (`Data.IsShortSum.bind`, the number of coset families at most tupleBound^{…}, `Data.card_matrix_le_tupleBound`; the weights are products of character values, roots of unity, and moving by t(x) keeps left inverses); equivariance and the identity remain.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨κ D.m * (range D.m).prod κ, (Φ · |>.bind (fun _ x ↦ edgeCharProd (t x) (D.path 0)) fun S
    x ↦ tupleAction (t x)⁻¹ S), fun ϑ ↦ ⟨⟨fun g ⟨G, G'⟩ f ↦ ?_, add_mul 2 2 _ ▸ (q ϑ).1.bind (by
    simp; grw [prod_le_pow_card _ _ (tupleBound ϑ)]; simp; exact fun p _ ↦ (card_le_of_embedding ⟨_,
    Units.val_injective.comp Quotient.out_injective⟩).trans (by simp [card_matrix_le_tupleBound]))
    fun S x _ n ↦ ⟨(CommMonoid.torsion ℂ).prod_mem fun _ _ ↦ (edgeChar ..).isOfFinOrder
    (Units.isUnit _).isOfFinOrder, fun e a b ↦ (n e a b).imp' ((t x e.1).1 * · * (t x e.2)⁻¹.1)
    fun L h ↦ by simp [tupleAction, ← L.mul_assoc, h]⟩⟩, fun r Ξ φ ↦ ?_⟩⟩

· simp [LinearMap.pi, ← sum_fn, ← Pi.smul_def, -smul_eq_mul]
    rw [mul_sum, ← (piCongrRight fun p ↦ toPerm (g (p.1, 0, p.2))).sum_comp, eq_comm]
    congr with x
    set y := piCongrRight _ x
    have E z i (h : i ≤ D.m) : (t' y _)⁻¹ * (g _ * t' x _) ∈ nodeLevel ϑ (z, 0, i) := by
      obtain rfl | h := h.eq_or_lt <;> simp [t', ← QuotientGroup.eq, y, ← Quotient.mk_smul_out, *]
    erw [← mul_assoc, ← edgeCharProd_mul, ← mul_inv_cancel_left (t y) (g * _), edgeCharProd_mul,
      mul_assoc, ← (q ϑ).2]
    delta tupleAction; simp
    rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩ _ <;> simp [t, *, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, Subgroup.mem_bot.1 (E false ..)]

steps.claim: unfold the bind as a sum over coset families;
re-index the sum by the action of g on the cosets (a permutation);
steps.lean: rw [mul_sum, ← (piCongrRight fun p ↦ toPerm (g (p.1, 0, p.2))).sum_comp, eq_comm]

steps.claim: let y be the re-indexed family;
t′(y)⁻¹·g·t′(x) lies in the node level at every (z, 0, i), i ≤ m;
steps.lean:
have E z i (h : i ≤ D.m) : (t' y _)⁻¹ * (g _ * t' x _) ∈ nodeLevel ϑ (z, 0, i) := by
      obtain rfl | h := h.eq_or_lt <;> simp [t', ← QuotientGroup.eq, y, ← Quotient.mk_smul_out, *]
steps.typed_fact: (t' y _)⁻¹ * (g _ * t' x _) ∈ nodeLevel ϑ (z, 0, i)

steps.claim: the edge products multiply (`Data.edgeCharProd_mul`) and the level-tidiness of Φ(ϑ) applies to the family t(y)⁻¹·g·t(x) of node-level elements;
steps.lean:
erw [← mul_assoc, ← edgeCharProd_mul, ← mul_inv_cancel_left (t y) (g * _), edgeCharProd_mul,
      mul_assoc, ← (q ϑ).2]

steps.claim: the families agree at every node (the value at (0, 0) of V is trivial, being in the trivial level of that node).
steps.lean: rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩ _ <;> simp [t, *, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, Subgroup.mem_bot.1 (E false ..)]

steps.claim: The identity: unfold gridPeriod and gridPathMap at stage 0, and move each term by its family t(x) with `Data.diagonalPeriodForm_tupleAction` (t(x) is 1 at the end nodes and block-extended at (0, 0)).
Insert the identity e of Φ(ϑ) and pull out the scalars.
The products of the κ's: the triangle orders are κ times level indices (step 1).
The level indices are the numbers of cosets (`Subgroup.index_eq_card`, `Data.levelIndex_eq_untwisted`).
